Ten cents is good power — that's the cheap end, so more of what it mines stays yours. The H15 Dual is $999, ships November 14, and mines Bitcoin and Dogecoin side by side.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?
Read the bsb b30 dual page
Searched the catalog · Magic Miner 40T Harlo B30

Straight comparison at your 10¢: the H15 Dual is 15 TH/s at 500 W, about $36 a month in power, $999, ships November 14. The Magic Miner 40T is 40 TH/s at 650 W, about $47 a month, $799, ships November 21 — nearly three times the Bitcoin hashrate for $200 less.

So it comes down to whether the Dogecoin side matters to you. Does it?

Then the H15 Dual is your unit — it's the only one we make that hashes Bitcoin and Dogecoin at the same time, 15 TH/s plus 1.08 GH/s scrypt, one 500 W box, about 50 dB. $999, ships November 14.

Want me to build the cart?
